sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: No Pieces of Heart: 13 whole containers, 5 from bosses and 8 from side activities. Link starts with 3 hearts and ends with 16.

items.name: Stagnox
items.howTo: Defeat Stagnox, the Forest Temple's boss.

items.name: Take 'Em All On! level 1
items.howTo: In the building at the south-east of Castle Town, pay 50 Rupees for the green door and clear its 10 rooms, ending with Stagnox. No hearts drop inside, so bring potions.

items.name: Bunnio: five rabbits
items.howTo: Catch any five rabbits and take them to Bunnio at Rabbitland Rescue.
items.notes: The first four Grass Rabbits and the Snow Rabbit west of Anouki Village are enough. The rabbits are in their own tracker.

items.name: Fraaz
items.howTo: Defeat Fraaz, the Snow Temple's boss.

items.name: Russell's sword training
items.howTo: After the Snow Temple a letter from Russell invites you back. In the training room on the castle's east side, land 60 hits on his three guards before they hit you three times. Stand between the right and bottom guards and turn on whichever winds up.
items.notes: The fee is 20 Rupees (Zelda Wiki, IGN) or 50 (Zelda Dungeon). Higher scores give Treasure; 200 hits gives a Regal Ring or Alchemy Stone (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Snow Sanctuary shop
items.howTo: Buy it for 2,000 Rupees in the Anouki shop by the Snow Sanctuary's station.
items.notes: Sell Treasure to Linebeck III at the Trading Post for the Rupees.

items.name: Phytops
items.howTo: Defeat Phytops, the Ocean Temple's boss.

items.name: Whip Race
items.howTo: With the Whip, swing across north Whittleton to the race at the north-east corner (50 Rupees) and finish in under 1:15.
items.notes: Under 1:30 wins the Medium Bomb Bag.

items.name: Cragma
items.howTo: Defeat Cragma, the Fire Temple's boss.

items.name: Pirate Hideout
items.howTo: Rescue Wadatsumi from the Pirate Hideout first (his Force Gem), then play the shooting minigame again and score 4,000 or more.
items.after: Niboshi's Force Gem (Mega Ice to Papuchia Village)
items.notes: IGN says 4,000–4,500 and that higher scores give Treasure instead; Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon say 4,000 or more. Keep the multiplier going by not missing.

items.name: Skeldritch
items.howTo: Defeat Skeldritch, the Sand Temple's boss.

items.name: Braintwister Block Puzzle
items.area: Ends of the Earth Station, west cave
items.howTo: Solve the three block-rolling puzzles in the Braintwister cave (the western one) at the Ends of the Earth Station.
items.after: Rael's Force Gem (five Cuccos to the Sand Sanctuary)
items.notes: The other two caves give a Treasure (Brainteaser, centre) and a Regal Ring (Brainmasher, east).

items.name: Beedle's Gold Card
items.howTo: Join Beedle's club (100 Rupees, after your first purchase) and earn 500 points, one per 10 Rupees spent, to become a Gold Member.
items.notes: 5,000 Rupees in all. His stock changes daily: buy his Treasure and sell what you don't need to Linebeck III.
